tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV/MCH/MCHC). Platelet count is within normal limits, but platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, suggesting increased platelet size variability, possibly due to reactive or regenerative processes. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are normal. Further evaluation of anemia and platelet morphology is recommended.
